terms.definition: The middle value of a dataset after sorting.
terms.function: Splits the sorted list in half.
terms.whyItMatters: The median is the trusty summary for skewed data.

terms.definition: The step of ordering data from lowest to highest.
terms.whereItIs: The ordered blocks on the track.

terms.definition: With an even number of values, average the two middle items.
terms.whyItMatters: Even counts need a between-middle value.

terms.definition: The median barely moves when an extreme value joins the data.
terms.function: Only position matters, not the outlier's size.
terms.whereItIs: Visible when a giant block joins at the end.
terms.whyItMatters: Resistance to outliers is the median's superpower.
